claims.text: Patient reports taking amlodipine 5 mg daily, as recorded in a staff note on 2026-07-28.
Clinician note states amlodipine was stopped because of ankle swelling, with blood pressure to be reviewed in two weeks.

citations.quote: Amlodipine was stopped because of ankle swelling; review blood pressure in two weeks.

open_questions: When was ankle swelling first recorded, and was it previously linked to amlodipine?
When was amlodipine first started, and at what dose?
What antihypertensive medications were tried before amlodipine, and were they stopped and why?
What are the most recent blood pressure readings before amlodipine was stopped?
Which allergies or reactions are recorded for this patient?
